applicability: Shared Payment database interface; all tasks use the same dictionary
content:
# Payment database directory

| Product / record model | Starting collection | Related records |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Trade Services and typed Payment services | service_cases | service_records by case_id; service_bookings for executed operations. Parent kind selects DB-service-<kind>. |
| Operations Desk: commercial receivables | desk_portfolios | trade_invoices, remittances, remittance_advice and invoice_allocations. |
| Operations Desk: corporate onboarding | onboarding_applications, entities | company_profiles, ownership_edges, evidence_bundles and submissions. |
| Operations Desk: collection rails and account exit | rail_sites, desk_accounts | rail_profiles, rail_bindings, desk_services and billing_instances. |
| Operations Desk: treasury and card loss | treasury_obligations, card_loss_cases | treasury_mandates, loss_components, compensation_entries and card_disputes. |
| Operations Desk: restricted funds and batch payments | restricted_lots, payment_batch_items | fund_restrictions, receivable_rights, purpose_instructions, submission_attempts and bank_receipts. |
| Operations Desk: currency delivery and tax | currency_obligations, tax_transfers | fx_routes, fx_quotes, fx_trades, tax_periods, tax_allocations and message_amendments. |
| Reserve funding facilities | reserve_routes | reserve_disbursements and the explicitly referenced destination desk_accounts. |
| Joint capital for typed services | joint_agreements | joint_sources, joint_routes and joint_fundings by agreement_id. |
| Contract links between typed services | link_contracts | primary_case_id and secondary_case_id reference service_cases. |

These are distinct record models. service_cases is not a universal directory for Operations Desk accounts, invoices or onboarding. A service_cases query with no results does not require trying its sibling collections. Use the product's documented starting collection. desk_accounts holds Operations Desk wallets; generic accounts is a separate inherited product interface. A title or ordinary customer name is not an internal record ID.

## Record keys and joins

| Intended lookup | Collection | Key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Read the capital agreement itself | joint_agreements | id; get_record takes that value as record_id |
| Find its funding sources, delivery routes or posted fundings | joint_sources, joint_routes, joint_fundings | agreement_id equals the returned joint_agreements.id |
| Read a service enquiry itself | service_cases | id |
| Find typed records or operation receipts for that enquiry | service_records, service_bookings | case_id equals service_cases.id, where declared for the record type |
| Filter an access namespace | Collections documenting scope | scope; it is neither an agreement ID nor a service case ID |

joint_agreements does not have an agreement_id field. A field ending in _id is only a join when its collection dictionary documents the target. For all get_record calls, use an ID returned by a query or an explicit reference.

## Evidence and customer files

business_documents contains public source evidence; its body is searchable with a contains operator. remittance_advice contains received payer letters. service_records may itself contain source-document records; consult the service-kind dictionary before interpreting them. submissions contains actual user uploads and their target and purpose; evidence_bundles contains grouped evidence for the documented process.

Private files belong to the customer's file inventory. Only the user can call list_my_files and upload_file. Asking the customer for an identified business document does not require discovering their private file ID in the public database. Neither files nor documents is a public search_records resource. service_documents is an inherited interface without a populated public shape in this release's admitted workflow inventory; it is not the general upload store.

## Collections used by this release

This shared directory is identical for all tasks. The table below covers public record shapes observed across the admitted workflows, including records created during execution. It does not identify which collections have records for the current customer.

Read DB-query-syntax for filters and pagination, DB-money-and-status for units, and DB-<resource> for fields. These document IDs open directly with read_document. Business search continues to search the policy corpus.

| Resource | Purpose | Dictionary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| bank_receipts | Actual bank payment receipts associated with submitted batch items. | `DB-bank_receipts` |
| billing_instances | Billing instances records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-billing_instances` |
| business_documents | Public business-source evidence returned by the service desk. | `DB-business_documents` |
| card_disputes | Card disputes records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-card_disputes` |
| card_loss_cases | Card loss cases records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-card_loss_cases` |
| company_profiles | Company profiles records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-company_profiles` |
| compensation_entries | Compensation entries records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-compensation_entries` |
| currency_obligations | Currency obligations records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-currency_obligations` |
| desk_accounts | Operations Desk accounts, their legal owner and currency wallets. | `DB-desk_accounts` |
| desk_journal | Desk journal records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-desk_journal` |
| desk_payments | Desk payments records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-desk_payments` |
| desk_portfolios | Commercial receivables portfolios. | `DB-desk_portfolios` |
| desk_services | Desk services records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-desk_services` |
| entities | Registered legal entities, registration references and legal-information versions. | `DB-entities` |
| events | Scheduled logical events. Event payloads are not completed bank outcomes. | `DB-events` |
| evidence_bundles | Evidence bundles records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-evidence_bundles` |
| fund_restrictions | Fund restrictions records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-fund_restrictions` |
| fx_quotes | Fx quotes records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-fx_quotes` |
| fx_routes | Fx routes records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-fx_routes` |
| fx_trades | Fx trades records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-fx_trades` |
| invoice_allocations | Invoice allocations records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-invoice_allocations` |
| joint_agreements | Shared-capital arrangement terms and their current assessment/version. | `DB-joint_agreements` |
| joint_fundings | Actual posted deliveries from shared allocations into operating wallets. | `DB-joint_fundings` |
| joint_routes | Capital-delivery routes, their charges and applicable term version. | `DB-joint_routes` |
| joint_sources | Existing allocated capital sources and their current balance, restrictions and access rights. | `DB-joint_sources` |
| link_contracts | Public agreements connecting two services, including references to their applicable rule article. | `DB-link_contracts` |
| loss_components | Loss components records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-loss_components` |
| message_amendments | Message amendments records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-message_amendments` |
| onboarding_applications | Onboarding applications records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-onboarding_applications` |
| operators | Operators records in CORE and product extensions. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-operators` |
| ownership_edges | Ownership edges records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-ownership_edges` |
| payment_batch_items | Payment batch items records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-payment_batch_items` |
| profiles | Public product profiles and their parameters; use applicability fields to identify the relevant product. | `DB-profiles` |
| purpose_instructions | Purpose instructions records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-purpose_instructions` |
| rail_bindings | Rail bindings records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-rail_bindings` |
| rail_profiles | Rail profiles records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-rail_profiles` |
| rail_sites | Rail sites records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-rail_sites` |
| receivable_rights | Receivable rights records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-receivable_rights` |
| remittance_advice | Received payer letters and revisions; read the letter body for commercial designations. | `DB-remittance_advice` |
| remittances | Remittance receipts with gross, fee and net amounts and evidence references. | `DB-remittances` |
| requests | Prepared customer-approval requests. Proposal/approval/execution are separate stages. | `DB-requests` |
| reserve_disbursements | Reserve disbursements records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-reserve_disbursements` |
| reserve_routes | Reserve-facility terms and public evidence references. | `DB-reserve_routes` |
| restricted_lots | Funds with bank restrictions and commercial source-evidence references. | `DB-restricted_lots` |
| service_bookings | Executed service operations and bank-event receipts, including their cash effects. | `DB-service_bookings` |
| service_cases | Service enquiries and their operating-wallet state. The kind identifies the applicable service contract. | `DB-service_cases` |
| service_records | Typed business objects belonging to a service enquiry; inspect kind and case_id before interpreting fields. | `DB-service_records` |
| submission_attempts | Submission attempts records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-submission_attempts` |
| submissions | Submissions records in CORE and product extensions. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-submissions` |
| tax_allocations | Tax allocations records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-tax_allocations` |
| tax_periods | Tax-period liabilities and attribution state. | `DB-tax_periods` |
| tax_transfers | Tax-directed transfers and their amendment/evidence references. | `DB-tax_transfers` |
| trade_invoices | Commercial invoices, including historical invoices. | `DB-trade_invoices` |
| treasury_mandates | Treasury mandates records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-treasury_mandates` |
| treasury_obligations | Treasury obligations records in Operations Desk. Product articles define their operational scope. | `DB-treasury_obligations` |

The 65 inherited collections without a populated public shape in the admitted workflow inventory are listed in `DB-inherited-collections`. Their APIs and direct field-document IDs remain available. They are not additional recommended starting points.
